title: Free Figma UX Design UI Essentials Course

best.what: clean, plain-language UI vs UX explanation (own banking-app example) -- same script also exists as the standalone clip rX9vee7ITVE

what a persona and a task flow are and why you scope a brief to one flow instead of designing everything -- the one segment in this 3h video with no Figma-mechanics equivalent elsewhere in the playlist
wireframe (lo-fi) vs high-fidelity mockup, and why you test with lo-fi first -- duplicated verbatim as the standalone clip UU_eyUGWIEI (already core)

why: 177-minute Figma software course (frames, type tool, rectangle/color-picker mechanics, icon import, pages, prototype transitions/easing, comment threads, Teams pricing) with three short conceptual segments worth lifting out; everything else is click-by-click Figma tutorial the kids will never use since Gemini builds their UI. Sampled: first 15 min, six ~3-min windows spread through the middle, last 10 min.

title: What is Figma?
why: Word-for-word re-cut of kbZejnPXyLM 0:05:39-0:09:21 ("what Figma is/isn't for, rapid prototyping vs coding"). A Figma product pitch, not a design concept; duplicate, skip.

title: Share Editing with other UX designers in Figma
why: Word-for-word re-cut of kbZejnPXyLM 2:49:22-2:56:34: Figma's Drafts/Teams/Team-Projects structure and the free-tier paywall (1 team project, 3 files). Entirely about Figma's own account/pricing model -- not applicable to Apps Script + Sheets. Skip.

title: Do I Need to Know Adobe Illustrator to Use Figma?
why: Whether a UX designer also needs Illustrator, with a live copy-paste demo between the two apps. Two enterprise design tools the kids will never touch; nothing transfers. Skip.

title: What is Low Fidelity Wireframes vs High Fidelity Wireframes in Figma

best.what: whole video: lo-fi vs hi-fi wireframes, why you test with boring gray/one-color lo-fi first so feedback is about the flow and not the colors/fonts

why: 3-minute standalone version of a genuinely transferable planning concept from the brief's own example list. Despite the title, nothing said requires Figma -- it's about process (sketch the flow cheap and plain before you make it pretty), which maps directly onto sketching a Sheet-backed app before building it in Gemini. Best kept as the short standalone rather than the 3-hour course.

title: Frames vs Groups in Figma
why: A deep dive into Figma's own object model (frames clip/nest/auto-layout, groups don't) and constraints. Entirely Figma's internal data structure, not a general UI concept, and confusing even for the presenter's own admission ("what a confusing video"). Skip.

title: UI vs UX Design in Figma

best.what: UI = how it looks, UX = how it works; UX starts when you put it in someone's hands and test
the bank app: pretty but Enter doesn't submit, clickable names show no sign they're clickable, no hand cursor

why: Six minutes, no Figma needed; the bank-app complaints are concrete UX bugs kids can spot in their own apps and name to Gemini (Enter submits the form, show that it's clickable).

title: Where to get Free icons for Figma

best.what: free vs free-with-credit licences; SVG vs PNG: 1 KB, scalable, recolourable

why: SVG vs PNG and 'check the licence' carry over to web apps (Gemini can paste SVG icons straight into the HTML); the Figma community half is tool mechanics.

title: Micro Interactions using interactive components in Figma
why: Only Figma variant wiring; hover/toggle states are covered better by the UI-states and juice videos.
